title: 第10章 第二次打工：去天庭当保安
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: “别紧张，我是来合租的。”苏沐雪尽量保持着高冷的微笑。“合租？！”夏晚晴瞪大了眼睛，看了看苏沐雪，又看了看叶凛。“老叶，你行啊！刚被秦菲菲甩了，转头就勾搭上了苏校花？”“这可是苏沐雪啊！咱们学校的高岭之花！你居然让她来住这种破地方？”“少废话。”叶凛把那瓶精油拧紧，揣进兜里。“她出钱，你出力，我负责收钱和统计。”“从今天开始，咱们就是相亲相爱的一家人了。”叶凛指了指狭窄的客厅。“苏同学，虽然你是校花，但丑话说在前头。”“进了这个门，咱们就是纯洁的金钱关系。”“第一，房租水电按时交，概不赊账。”“第二，公共区域卫生轮流打扫，但我那份可以用技术入股抵扣，比如修水管或者换灯泡。”“第三，也是最重要的一点。”叶凛竖起一根手指，语气变得异常严肃。“不管你在外面看到了什么，听到了什么，哪怕天塌下来，也不要打扰我睡觉和下班。”“我是个很有原则的人。”苏沐雪看着叶凛那副斤斤计较的嘴脸，心里冷笑一声。原则？刚才在屋里搞出那么大动静，现在跟我谈原则？不过是个有点姿色的小白脸罢了，估计是靠着夏晚晴养着。上一世夏晚晴成神后一直单身，有男的试图接近她都会有很大的反应。看来就是被这个渣男给伤透了心。苏沐雪觉得自已真相了。她看向夏晚晴的眼神里充满了同情和怜爱。放心吧大圣，这一世，有我在，绝不会让你再被这个渣男吸血了！“没问题。”苏沐雪打开手包，数出厚厚一叠现金。这是她攒了很久的生活费，本来打算换个新手机的。她的手指捏着钞票的一角，指节微微发白。有点心疼。但为了抱上大腿，这笔投资必须花！“这是三个月的房租和押金。”“不用找了。”她尽量让自已的动作看起来潇洒，把钱拍在鞋柜上。叶凛的眼睛瞬间亮了。原本那副没睡醒的死鱼眼，此刻仿佛装了两台点钞机，精准地扫描着那叠红票子的厚度。“爽快。”叶凛一把捞过钱，甚至没数，直接揣进兜里。动作熟练得让人心疼。“我就喜欢和你这种爽快人做朋友。”“那你们聊，我去洗个手。”说完，他转身钻进了那个狭小的卫生间。随着卫生间门关上，客厅里只剩下了苏沐雪和夏晚晴两个人。气氛一度非常尴尬。夏晚晴挠了挠头，那头短发被她抓成了鸡窝，身上还散发着那股好闻的玫瑰香。“那个……苏校花，你真要住这儿啊？”夏晚晴还是觉得有点不真实。苏沐雪这种级别的女神，不应该在这个连转身都困难的出租屋里，闻着隔壁飘来的油烟味。不过夏晚晴显然没意识到自已长得也不赖。“叫我沐雪就好。”苏沐雪放下身段，走到夏晚晴身边。她必须尽快和这个未来的“大腿”建立感情，顺便把她从叶凛这个渣男手里解救出来。“我觉得这里挺好的，有生活气息。”苏沐雪违心地说着瞎话，视线却在夏晚晴身上扫视。这一看，她心里的震惊更甚。上一世她见过夏晚晴还没觉醒时的样子。虽然身体素质不错，但绝对没有现在这么……夸张。怎么可能？现在的夏晚晴应该还没接触到神像才对，为什么身体素质已经进化到了这个地步？难道是因为叶凛刚才给她涂的那个东西？苏沐雪的目光飘向卫生间紧闭的门。不，不可能。叶凛手里拿的也就是普通的精油吧，估计是用来助兴的。夏晚晴这应该是天赋异禀，不愧是未来的齐天大圣！苏沐雪更加坚定了要抱紧夏晚晴大腿的决心。“那个……沐雪啊。”夏晚晴被苏沐雪盯得有点发毛，下意识地抱住了胸口。“你别这么看着我，虽然我刚被老叶按通了经络，感觉浑身舒畅，但我取向很正常的。”“按通经络？”苏沐雪敏锐地捕捉到了关键词，眼神一冷。果然。这就是渣男惯用的借口。“对啊！”夏晚晴一脸兴奋，完全没意识到自已在说什么虎狼之词。她挥了挥拳头，带起一阵风声。“你不知道，老叶那手艺绝了！”“虽然疼得我想死，但按完之后，我感觉我能一拳打死一头牛！”“而且……”夏晚晴凑到苏沐雪耳边，神秘兮兮地说道：“刚才照镜子，都大了一圈！”苏沐雪：“……”她看着夏晚晴那确实比记忆中要挺拔不少的曲线，再联想到叶凛那双修长有力的手。按摩？鬼才信！这分明就是那个渣男用来哄骗单纯少女的借口！苏沐雪在心里给叶凛狠狠记了一笔。……卫生间的门隔绝了外面两个女人的视线。叶凛拧开水龙头，捧起一捧冷水泼在脸上。冰凉的触感让他有些发胀的大脑清醒了不少。镜子里那张苍白的脸挂着水珠，看起来依旧是一副没精打采的死样。“两万三千五……”他对着镜子里的自已比了个“耶”的手势。这一波血赚。不仅找了个免费的强力保镖，还顺带解决了一年的房租问题，甚至还有富余。至于苏沐雪那个女人……叶凛扯过毛巾擦了擦脸。只要钱到位，她就算要在客厅里供个奥特曼他也懒得管。就在这时，那块只有他能看见的淡蓝色光幕毫无征兆地弹了出来。【叮！】【检测到优质雇主发布紧急委托！】【是否接取新订单？】叶凛擦脸的动作一顿。优质客户？上次那个阿芙洛狄忒虽然事儿多，但给的精油确实是好东西。既然决定要在这个神魔乱舞的世界里当个最强打工人，那就没有把生意往外推的道理。况且，他现在确实缺钱。缺血汗钱，也缺能让自已在这个世界立足的真正资本。“接取。”意念一动。光幕展开，一行金光闪闪的大字差点闪瞎他的眼。【委托任务：天庭蟠桃园临时保安（急聘！）】【雇主：昊天金阙无上至尊自然妙有弥罗至真玉皇上帝（玉皇大帝）】【岗位职责：在蟠桃盛会前夕，看守蟠桃园，防止孙悟空进入园区偷吃。】【系统提示：因传送通道被赫菲斯托斯影响，正在维修传送通道，本次神界与蓝星时间差为1:3】【系统特别备注：该时期孙悟空尚未食用蟠桃与金丹，实力约为金仙到太乙金仙之间。】【报酬：血汗钱*100，雇主的随机赏赐】
content_en: "Don't be nervous, I'm here to share the house." Su Muxue tried her best to maintain a cold smile."Shared room?!" Xia Wanqing's eyes widened, she looked at Su Muxue and then at Ye Lin."Old Ye, you can do it! You were just dumped by Qin Feifei and you hooked up with the school belle of Su?" "This is Su Muxue! The flower of our school! You actually let her live in such a shabby place?" "Stop talking nonsense." Ye Lin tightened the bottle of essential oil and put it in his pocket."She pays, you contribute, and I'm responsible for collecting the money and statistics." "From today on, we are a family that loves each other." Ye Lin pointed to the narrow living room."Student Su, although you are the school beauty, you have said ugly things first." "After entering this door, we have a purely monetary relationship." "First, the rent, water and electricity are paid on time, and there is no credit." "Second, public areas are cleaned in turn, but my share can be deducted with technical shares, such as repairing water pipes or changing light bulbs." "Third, and the most important point." Ye Lin raised a finger and his tone became extremely serious."No matter what you see or hear outside, even if the sky falls, don't disturb my sleep and get off work." "I am a very principled person." Su Muxue looked at Ye Lin's worried face and sneered in her heart.in principle?You just made such a big noise in the house, now you want to talk to me about principles?He's just a pretty pretty boy, and he probably relies on Xia Wanqing for his support.In her previous life, Xia Wanqing had been single since she became a god. Any man who tried to approach her would have a big reaction.It seems that he was heartbroken by this scumbag.Su Muxue felt that she had discovered the truth.She looked at Xia Wanqing with eyes full of sympathy and love.Don't worry, Great Sage, in this life, with me here, I will never let you be sucked by this scumbag again!"No problem." Su Muxue opened her handbag and counted out a thick stack of cash.This was the living expenses she had saved for a long time, and she originally planned to buy a new mobile phone.Her fingers held the corner of the bill, her knuckles turning slightly white.A little distressed.But in order to grab the upper hand, this investment must be spent!"This is three months' rent and deposit." "No need to look for it." She tried her best to make her movements look chic and patted the money on the shoe cabinet.Ye Lin's eyes lit up instantly.The dead fish eyes that were still awake now seemed to be equipped with two money counting machines, accurately scanning the thickness of the stack of red bills."It's refreshing." Ye Lin grabbed the money and put it directly into his pocket without even counting it.The movements are so skillful that it makes people feel distressed."I just like to be friends with cheerful people like you." "Then you guys chat, and I'll wash my hands." After saying that, he turned around and got into the small bathroom.As the bathroom door closed, only Su Muxue and Xia Wanqing were left in the living room.The atmosphere was very awkward for a time.Xia Wanqing scratched her head. Her short hair was turned into a chicken coop, and her body still exuded the delicious scent of roses."Um...Su school beauty, do you really want to live here?" Xia Wanqing still felt a bit unreal.A goddess of Su Muxue's level should not be in this rental house where it is difficult to even turn around, smelling the smell of oil smoke coming from next door.But Xia Wanqing obviously didn't realize that she wasn't bad looking either."Just call me Muxue." Su Muxue put down her body and walked to Xia Wanqing.She must establish a relationship with this future "thigh" as soon as possible and rescue her from Ye Lin, a scumbag."I think it's nice here, it has the atmosphere of life." Su Muxue told lies against her will, but her eyes glanced at Xia Wanqing.This sight made her even more shocked.In the last life, she had seen Xia Wanqing before she woke up.Although his physical fitness is good, it is definitely not as... exaggerated as it is now.How is it possible?Xia Wanqing probably hasn't come into contact with the idol yet. Why has her physical fitness evolved to this point?Could it be because of the thing Ye Lin applied to her just now?Su Muxue's eyes drifted to the closed door of the bathroom.No, not possible.What Ye Lin was holding was just ordinary essential oil, probably for fun.Xia Wanqing must be extremely talented and worthy of being the future Monkey King!Su Muxue became more determined to hold Xia Wanqing's thigh tightly."Um...Muxue." Xia Wanqing was a little frightened by Su Muxue's stare, and she subconsciously hugged her chest."Don't look at me like that. Although I just had my meridians pressed by Lao Ye and I feel comfortable all over, my orientation is normal." "The meridians were pressed?" Su Muxue keenly captured the key words and her eyes turned cold.really.This is the excuse used by scumbags."Yes!" Xia Wanqing looked excited, completely unaware of what she was saying.She waved her fist, causing a gust of wind."You don't know, Lao Ye's skills are amazing!" "Although it hurts so much that I want to die, after pressing it, I feel like I can kill a cow with one punch!" "And..." Xia Wanqing leaned close to Su Muxue's ear and said mysteriously: "When I looked in the mirror just now, I was a lot bigger!" Su Muxue: "..." She looked at Xia Wanqing's curves that were indeed much straighter than she remembered, and then thought of Ye Lin's slender and powerful hands.massage?Only a ghost can believe it!This is obviously the excuse used by that scumbag to deceive the innocent girl!Su Muxue made a serious note to Ye Lin in her heart....The bathroom door blocked the sight of the two women outside.Ye Lin turned on the faucet and poured a handful of cold water on his face.The cold touch sobered up his somewhat swollen brain.The pale face in the mirror was dripping with water and still looked listless."Twenty-three thousand and five thousand..." He gestured "yeah" to himself in the mirror.This wave of blood profit.Not only did he find a free and powerful bodyguard, but he also solved the rent problem for a year and even had a surplus.As for that woman Su Muxue... Ye Lin pulled the towel and wiped her face.As long as the money is in place, he won't even bother to provide an Ultraman in the living room if she wants to.At this moment, the light blue light curtain that only he could see popped up without warning.【bite!】【Quality employer detected and issued emergency commission!】【Do you want to accept new orders?] Ye Lin wiped his face for a moment.Premium customers?Although Aphrodite had a lot of things to do last time, the essential oils she gave her were indeed good things.Since you have decided to be the strongest worker in this world where gods and demons dance, there is no reason to push the business outside.Besides, he is really short of money now.Lack of hard-earned money, and lack of real capital to allow oneself to gain a foothold in this world."Take it." A thought came to mind.The light curtain unfolded, and a line of large golden characters almost blinded him.[Entrusted task: Temporary security guard of the Tianting Peach Garden (urgent!)] [Employer: Haotian Golden Tower, the Supreme Supreme Natural Miracle, the True Jade Emperor (Jade Emperor)] [Job Responsibilities: On the eve of the Peach Festival, guard the Peach Garden to prevent Sun Wukong from entering the park to eat.】【System prompt: Because the transmission channel is affected by Hephaestus, the transmission channel is being repaired. The time difference between the God Realm and Blue Star is 1:3 this time.】[System special note: Sun Wukong has not eaten the flat peach and golden elixir during this period, and his strength is between the Golden Immortal and the Taiyi Golden Immortal.】【Reward: Hard-earned money * 100, random reward from the employer】
